objective: Discriminate a retrieval-specific mechanism from feedback, expectancy, and exposure-time alternatives.
intervention: Randomly assign spaced retrieval practice with standardized feedback.
comparator: Rereading with matched total study time and identical feedback schedule.
falsification_rule: Reject the registered mechanism claim if the delayed-recall contrast is below the minimum practically relevant effect and the confidence interval excludes that threshold.
assumptions: study time and feedback exposure are equivalent across groups
outcome scoring is blinded and measurement invariance is acceptable
data_management_plan: Use de-identified project data under the registered retention policy.
stopping_rule: Stop after the preregistered sample size or a safety block.
